opening.argument: The presentation offers a purported one-BNB reward through TokenFlux using a secret members-only code and a pinned link. Withdrawal is then tied to level-two verification and at least $100 of activity on a real, rather than bonus, balance. The speaker says he will send 100 USDT for that requirement, and a TokenFlux assets page shows a BNB balance of 1. Although the process is framed as free educational content, the observable sequence connects the claimed reward to asset activity. The displayed balances do not, by themselves, establish a completed transfer or withdrawal, but the solicitation asks viewers to pursue the reward through a process that includes the stated real-balance requirement.
